title: tape-archiver-web values
description: Describes config.web.presets only; every other value is documented in values.yaml.

presets.description: Named partial run configs offered by the "Start new run" page (issue #417, docs/web-ui.md "Run presets").

name.description: Unique preset name shown in the picker.

description.description: Optional operator-facing description shown under the name.

config.description: Any subset of the run config (schemas/run-config.schema.json). cmd/web validates it at startup merged with the deploy-owned fields. Secrets are not allowed.

encryption.description: encryption.identity is a private key and must be entered per run, never in a preset.
